plan.title: docs/process: always-load win32 issue-body RMW footgun (PS string[]/OFS)

narratives.Description: Win32 agents keep destroying live GitHub issue bodies on amend even after #2646 (safe write via --body-file). The failure mode is read-modify-write: capture gh api --jq .body into a PowerShell variable, concatenate, write temp, PATCH. #2607 shipped fail-closed postcondition verify and scm:body:issue:fetch; this issue closes the always-load process gap so agents stop taking the capture-concat path.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Edit content/scm/github.md to add an always-load section naming the win32 PowerShell string[]/$OFS issue-body RMW footgun; include ⊗ capture-concat of gh api --jq .body and ! recipe using task scm:body:issue:fetch --out-file plus task scm:body:issue:edit (postcondition verify from #2607 packages/core/src/intake/github-body.ts). 2. Mirror the same !/⊗ into content/templates/agents-entry.md and content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md § Windows PowerShell bodies; run task agents:refresh and confirm AGENTS.md managed-section refresh. 3. Cite incidents #2087 / #2741 / #1492 in the scm note. 4. Append CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]; verify with task agents:refresh exit 0.
narratives.UserStory: As a win32 agent amending issue bodies, I want always-loaded RMW guidance forbidding PS string capture-concat, so that I use scm:body fetch-to-file plus verified edit instead of silent body corruption.

narrative.Acceptance: Given AGENTS.md / scm/github.md / preamble surfaces, when an agent loads them, then the PS string[]/OFS RMW footgun is named, capture-concat is forbidden, and the recipe points at scm:body:issue:fetch plus scm:body:issue:edit (postcondition verify).
Given consumer-relevant rule text lands, when task agents:refresh runs, then agents-entry contract markers remain satisfied.
Given the docs land, when CHANGELOG is reviewed, then [Unreleased] notes the always-load RMW guidance.
